fieldValues.comment_text: Dissent (agent reviewer, 2026-11-09, recorded by hand per remedy 2829dcf3): the live use of this split rests on too few decisions. The reviewer of local-lab detect.mjs (semanticops.com#65) judged "qwen for potential decisions only" directionally supported but weak, because qwen's real-meeting decision precision came from 5 flags, and 3 after the corrected re-run (all 3 right, but only 3 raised in 52 minutes). Precision on 3 says little; decision recall on real speech is unmeasured, because the sonnet judge sees only what was flagged. The builder accepted the recommendation and recorded the limit; it was not resolved. Bears on this decision's revisit trigger "the detector's recall against a frontier reference falls below half on a new task": live detection is a new task, and its recall has not been measured. Sources: semanticops.com#65 (review and corrected run report), finding 81a34482, the-greenman/transcribe#10.
